policy_metadata.policy_title: Laboratory – Fecal Analysis in the Diagnosis of Intestinal Dysbiosis

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Analysis of the following components IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for the evaluation of intestinal dysbiosis, irritable bowel syndrome, malabsorption or small intestinal overgrowth of bacteria: ­ Aerobic bacterial culture (CPT code 87077) ­ Anaerobic bacterial culture (CPT code 87076) ­ Beta-glucoronidase (CPT code 84311) ­ Cholesterol (CPT code 82715) ­ Chymotrypsin (CPT code 84311) ­ Fecal secretory immunoglobulin A (IgA) (CPT code 82784) ­ Identification or quantitation of fecal yeast (CPT code 87102, CPT code 87106) ­ Iso-butyrate, iso-valerate and n-valerate (CPT code 82542) ­ Long chain fatty acids (CPT code 82542, CPT code 82725) ­ Meat or vegetable fibers (CPT code 89160) ­ N-butyrate (CPT code 82542) ­ Potential of hydrogen (pH) (CPT code 83986) ­ Short chain fatty acid distribution (CPT code 82542) ­ Total short chain fatty acids (CPT code 82542) ­ Triglycerides (CPT code 82710)
